name: Mayfair Hotel
heritage: National Register of Historic Places listed place
text: The Mayfair Hotel is a historic hotel in the Westlake neighborhood of Los Angeles, California. The Sun Realty Company commissioned the building in 1926 and architectural firm Curlett & Beelman designed it in the Renaissance Revival style. The hotel opened on February 1, 1927.

depictions.name: Mayfair Hotel
depictions.text: The is a landmark in L.A. Noire. It is located on the south side 7th Street, at the short Witmer Street.
